scope: Bounded indirect Greek quotation evidence for Hermas S.9.xvi.5-7; not a full Clement or Hermas manuscript collation.

source.edition: Otto Stählin, Clemens Alexandrinus II, Stromata I-VI, Leipzig 1906
source.rights: Public-domain 1906 printed edition; own reading of scanned page, no modern digital transcription used as primary input.
source.citation: Stromata II.9.44.2-3; quotation at printed lines 11-20
source.method: Read rendered title leaf to verify 1906, then rendered page 136 and its apparatus. Archive OCR used to locate the leaf, not to certify its readings.

evidence_type: indirect Greek quotation in another author's transmitted work
independence: Clement's quotation is a distinct route of transmission from the continuous Athos Hermas codex. Editions and their sources must not be counted as separate votes; a quotation is not a continuous Hermas manuscript. The Clement edition's L siglum is local to Clement, not Hermas Latin L1/L2.

bounded_transcription.text: κατέβησαν οὖν μετ᾿ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ πάλιν ἀνέβησαν. ἀλλ᾿ οὗτοι ζῶντες κατέβησαν καὶ πάλιν ζῶντες ἀνέβησαν· ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οἱ προκεκοιμημένοι νεκροὶ κατέβησαν, ζῶντες δὲ ἀνέβησαν.
bounded_transcription.normalization: Printed line breaks joined; quotation glyphs and apostrophes normalized. No manuscript-image transcription claim.

circularity_checks.implication: The editor explicitly adopts Hermas wording here. The corrected printed wording is not independent Clement manuscript support for the Hermas tense or pronoun.
Do not count the editorial insertion as surviving Clement evidence.

circularity_checks.observation: The edition distinguishes Clement συνήρμοσαν, μόνην and ἔσχον from the respective Hermas forms. The quotation is not mechanically identical to the printed Hermas text.
circularity_checks.implication: Compare each word separately; do not use the quotation to replace all of S.9.xvi.5-7 wholesale.

decision.selected: Retain the working clause, including καὶ πάλιν ζῶντες ἀνέβησαν, while preserving the raw edition's bars and square brackets in the source layer.
decision.english_if_retained: But these went down alive and came up alive again; those who had previously fallen asleep went down dead but came up alive.
decision.english_without_inner_phrase: But these went down alive; those who had previously fallen asleep went down dead but came up alive.
decision.english_if_whole_clause_omitted: Then the paragraph continues directly from their descent and ascent to: Through these, therefore, they were made alive and recognized the name of the Son of God.
decision.rationale: The acquired Clement edition prints the inner phrase continuously without an editorial-supply mark or local apparatus attribution to Hermas. The Hermas edition reports the whole clause absent in A by homoeoteleuton, with different partial omissions in the Latin/Ethiopic versions. Repeated ascent/descent endings make accidental omission plausible. This supports retention as quotation-attested working wording, not a claim of unanimous continuous Greek attestation.
decision.limits: Direct individual Latin/Ethiopic manuscript comparison and Clement manuscript-image verification remain pending. No independent reviewer or completed whole-chapter adjudication is claimed. No reader English is changed by this record.
